$comment: Declarative manifest for www.tdpdf.com. build/ghost/publish-site.ps1 reads this and
nothing else decides what the site contains.
'source' is relative to this file. A source that points OUTSIDE build/ghost/ is a
repository document being published verbatim: it is read at publish time, every time,
so the page cannot drift from the file the application actually ships. Do not
'fix' such a page by editing it in the Ghost editor — the next publish overwrites it.
'regenerate' names a script that must run before the source is read, so a generated
source file cannot be published stale. It runs only under -Regenerate (it needs a
restored NuGet cache), and the script warns when a page that declares one is published

site.title: TDPdf
site.description: A PDF editor for Windows that installs without an administrator, verifies its own redactions, and reports to nobody by default.

pages.title: TDPdf
pages.metaTitle: TDPdf — a PDF editor for Windows that keeps quiet
pages.metaDescription: Redaction that verifies itself on the finished file and refuses to save if marked text survived. One self-contained exe, installed per user with no admin rights. Nothing phones home by default. GPLv3.
pages.note: Served at /home/ until routes.yaml is uploaded once — see build/ghost/theme/routes.yaml.

pages.title: Download
pages.metaDescription: Download TDPdf for Windows 10 and 11, verify the SHA256 checksum, and get the GPLv3 corresponding source for the exact binary you ran.

pages.title: Privacy
pages.metaDescription: Exactly what TDPdf sends, when, and to whom — enumerated from the source in Diagnostics/. With no destination configured, nothing leaves your machine.

pages.title: Third-party licences
pages.metaDescription: Every third-party component inside the TDPdf executable, with its copyright notice and licence text, including the native payloads no licence scanner can see.

pages.title: Telemetry
pages.metaDescription: How to point TDPdf at your own OTLP collector, what it sends when you do, and why a build with no policy configured reports to nobody.
